summary: Filters an angular collision response by comparing the total wrapped angular difference between a source orientation (a2, three Euler angles) and a target orientation (a3) against a scaled threshold. If the total difference is zero or does not exceed the threshold (this[0xA4] * a5 * total), the source Euler angles are copied unchanged to the output buffer a4. Otherwise both orientations are converted to quaternions, slerped by a factor clamped between threshold/total and 1.0, and the result is converted back to Euler angles written into a4. Called by sub_458DF0 (00458DF0).

local_names.a2: source Euler-angle triple (wrapped in place, passed through on the early-out path)
local_names.a3: target Euler-angle triple, also reused as the threshold accumulator
local_names.a4: output buffer receiving three Euler angles
local_names.a5: external multiplier scaling the response threshold
local_names.v5: float pointer view of the source orientation a2
local_names.v7: float pointer view of the target orientation a3
local_names.v14: quaternion staging buffer for the target orientation
local_names.v13: quaternion staging buffer for the source orientation

operations.description: Initialize local source/target float pointers from the integer-typed arguments; function is invoked by sub_458DF0 (00458DF0).
AngleWrap each component of the source Euler triple (offset 0 and offset 4 of the source pointer).
AngleWrap each component of the target Euler triple (offset 0 and offset 1 of the target pointer).
Compute per-component absolute differences between the wrapped source and target Euler angles, storing them back into the a3/a2 accumulator slots.
AngleNormalization of both accumulated angular differences to bring them into the canonical range.
Sum the two normalized differences into the total angular difference carried in a2.
Compute the response threshold = total_angular_difference * this[0xA4] * a5.
If the total angular difference is at most the threshold, or at most 0.0, skip quaternion interpolation entirely.
Early-out path: copy the three source Euler dwords into the output buffer a4 and return it unchanged.
Interpolation factor = threshold / total_angular_difference, clamped to 1.0 when the ratio exceeds 1.0.
QuaternionFromEulerAngles converts the target Euler triple into quaternion staging buffer v14.
QuaternionFromEulerAngles converts the source Euler triple into quaternion staging buffer v13.
sub_567580 performs spherical linear interpolation between the two quaternions with the computed factor.
sub_567010 converts the interpolated quaternion back to Euler angles in the output buffer a4 and returns it.
Return the output buffer pointer a4 on both paths.
